title: FAA issues national ground stop halting US flights
excerpt: The FAA imposed a nationwide ground stop on US flights due to a temporary telecommunications outage, citing safety concerns.
body_html:
A national ground stop temporarily halted takeoffs at airports across the United States. The Federal Aviation Administration implemented the directive due to extraordinary circumstances and for safety reasons following a temporary telecommunications outage.

While departures were largely stopped, aircraft already in the air were permitted to continue their flights and land safely. The agency announced the temporary telecommunications issue shortly after the stop was put into effect.
